verses.text: Look, the LORD's arm is not too short to save, and his ear is not too dull to hear.
But your sins have separated you from your God. Your sins have made him hide his face from you, so that he does not hear.
Your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with guilt. Your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue whispers evil.
No one goes to court honestly. No one argues their case truthfully. They trust in empty arguments and tell lies. They plan trouble and give birth to evil.
They hatch the eggs of poisonous snakes and weave spider webs. Whoever eats their eggs will die, and when one is broken, a snake comes out.
Their webs cannot be made into clothes. They cannot cover themselves with what they make. Their works are evil, and their hands are full of violence.
Their feet run to do evil. They hurry to kill innocent people. Their thoughts are evil thoughts. Ruin and destruction mark their roads.
They do not know the way of peace. There is no justice in their paths. They have made their roads crooked. No one who walks on them will know peace.
So justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We look for light, but there is only darkness. We look for brightness, but we walk in deep shadows.
We feel our way along the wall like the blind, feeling our way like people without eyes. At noon we stumble as if it were dusk. Among the strong, we are like the dead.
We all growl like bears. We moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none. We look for salvation, but it is far away.
For our rebellions against you are many, and our sins speak against us. Our rebellions are always with us, and we know our sins well:
we have rebelled against the LORD and denied him. We have turned our backs on our God. We have talked about cruelty and rebellion. We have planned lies in our hearts and spoken them.
So justice is pushed back, and righteousness stands far away. Truth has stumbled in the streets, and honesty cannot enter.
Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever turns away from evil becomes a victim. The LORD saw this, and he was displeased that there was no justice.
He saw that there was no one to help, and he was shocked that no one stepped in. So his own arm brought salvation, and his righteousness held him up.
He put on righteousness like armor on his chest, and the helmet of salvation on his head. He put on the clothes of revenge and wrapped himself in burning love like a cloak.
He will repay them for what they have done: anger for his enemies and payback for those who oppose him. He will repay the islands what they deserve.
From the west, people will respect the name of the LORD. From the rising of the sun, they will honor his glory. For he will come like a rushing river, driven by the breath of the LORD.
"The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn away from their sins," says the LORD.

"As for me, this is my covenant with them," says the LORD. "My Spirit, who is on you, and my words that I have put in your mouth, will never leave your mouth, or the mouths of your children, or the mouths of their descendants, from now on and forever," says the LORD.
